```python
# 推斷：資料表=料表（表頭第2列）｜欄位=狀態（位於「我方確認」區塊）｜篩選=狀態值 != "PASS"｜輸出=新工作表「我方確認非PASS」
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["料表"]

# 建立合併儲存格範圍與第1列區塊標題的對照
group_by_col = {}
for merged_range in ws.merged_cells.ranges:
    # 只處理第1列的橫向合併
    if merged_range.min_row == 1 and merged_range.max_row == 1:
        group_title = ws.cell(row=1, column=merged_range.min_col).value
        for col in range(merged_range.min_col, merged_range.max_col + 1):
            group_by_col[col] = group_title

# 讀取第2列欄位名稱
headers = []
for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
    headers.append(ws.cell(row=2, column=col).value)

# 找出「我方確認」區塊底下的「狀態」欄位索引（0-based）
status_col_idx = None
for idx, header in enumerate(headers):
    if header == "狀態" and group_by_col.get(idx + 1) == "我方確認":
        status_col_idx = idx
        break

if status_col_idx is None:
    raise ValueError("找不到「我方確認」區塊底下的「狀態」欄位")

# 建立新工作表
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title="我方確認非PASS")

# 寫入第2列的表頭
new_ws.append(headers)

# 從第3列開始篩選，狀態不是「PASS」的資料列才複製
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=3, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    status_value = row[status_col_idx]
    if status_value != "PASS":
        new_ws.append(row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
src = wb["組立清單"]

HEADER_ROW = 2
DATA_START = HEADER_ROW + 1

# 用第1列的合併群組標題 + 第2列欄名建立對照，以消歧兩個「M/S」
merged_ranges = list(src.merged_cells.ranges)

def group_of(col):
    for rng in merged_ranges:
        if rng.min_row <= 1 <= rng.max_row and rng.min_col <= col <= rng.max_col:
            return src.cell(row=rng.min_row, column=rng.min_col).value
    return src.cell(row=1, column=col).value

target_col = None
for col in range(1, src.max_column + 1):
    row2_val = src.cell(row=HEADER_ROW, column=col).value
    group = group_of(col)
    if group == "實測值" and row2_val == "M/S":
        target_col = col

if target_col is None:
    raise ValueError("找不到「實測值」區的「M/S」欄位")

# 篩選「M/S」非「正常」的資料列
filtered_rows = []
for row in range(DATA_START, src.max_row + 1):
    ms_val = src.cell(row=row, column=target_col).value
    if ms_val != "正常":
        filtered_rows.append([
            src.cell(row=row, column=c).value
            for c in range(1, src.max_column + 1)
        ])

# 建立新工作表
new_sheet_name = "實測值異常"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[new_sheet_name]
dst = wb.create_sheet(title=new_sheet_name)

# 寫入表頭（第2列原始欄名）
header_values = [
    src.cell(row=HEADER_ROW, column=c).value
    for c in range(1, src.max_column + 1)
]
dst.append(header_values)

# 寫入篩選後資料
for r in filtered_rows:
    dst.append(r)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=用料明細（表頭第2列）｜欄位=第2列欄名（以第1列群組標題消歧）｜主檔=用料明細｜鍵=舊版檢驗結果｜篩選=舊版檢驗結果不是"ok"｜輸出=新工作表
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["用料明細"]

HEADER_ROW = 2
GROUP_ROW = 1

# 用第1列的合併儲存格建立「欄位群組」對照，以消歧第2列的重複欄名
group_map = {}
for merged in ws.merged_cells.ranges:
    if merged.min_row <= GROUP_ROW <= merged.max_row:
        group_name = ws.cell(row=GROUP_ROW, column=merged.min_col).value
        for col in range(merged.min_col, merged.max_col + 1):
            group_map[col] = group_name

max_col = ws.max_column
headers = []
qualified_names = []
for col in range(1, max_col + 1):
    group = group_map.get(col, ws.cell(row=GROUP_ROW, column=col).value)
    name = ws.cell(row=HEADER_ROW, column=col).value
    headers.append(name)
    qualified_names.append(f"{group}_{name}")

# 定位「舊版」的「檢驗結果」
target = "舊版_檢驗結果"
if target not in qualified_names:
    raise ValueError(f"找不到目標欄位：{target}")
target_idx = qualified_names.index(target)

# 篩選舊版檢驗結果不是 "ok" 的資料列
filtered_rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(
    min_row=HEADER_ROW + 1,
    max_row=ws.max_row,
    min_col=1,
    max_col=max_col,
    values_only=True,
):
    val = row[target_idx]
    val_str = "" if val is None else str(val).strip()
    if val_str.lower() != "ok":
        filtered_rows.append(row)

# 建立新工作表，欄位用第2列的欄名
new_name = "舊版檢驗異常"
if new_name in wb.sheetnames:
    new_name = "舊版檢驗異常_1"
ws_new = wb.create_sheet(title=new_name)

ws_new.append(headers)
for row in filtered_rows:
    ws_new.append(row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=零件清單（表頭第2列）｜欄位=本廠檢驗結果｜主檔=零件清單｜鍵=項次｜篩選=本廠檢驗結果≠「無異常」｜輸出=新工作表
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["零件清單"]

HEADER_ROW = 2
DATA_START_ROW = 3

# 用第 1 列的合併群組標題消歧，建立「欄位 → 群組」對照
group_map = {}
for merged_range in ws.merged_cells.ranges:
    if merged_range.min_row <= 1 <= merged_range.max_row:
        group_title = ws.cell(row=merged_range.min_row, column=merged_range.min_col).value
        for col in range(merged_range.min_col, merged_range.max_col + 1):
            group_map[col] = group_title

# 找出「本廠」區塊的「檢驗結果」欄位
target_col = None
for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
    group = group_map.get(col, "")
    field = ws.cell(row=HEADER_ROW, column=col).value
    if group == "本廠" and field == "檢驗結果":
        target_col = col
        break

if target_col is None:
    raise ValueError("找不到「本廠」區塊的「檢驗結果」欄位")

# 建立新工作表
new_sheet_name = "本廠異常"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    wb.remove(wb[new_sheet_name])
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_sheet_name)

# 寫入表頭（第 2 列的欄名）
header_values = [ws.cell(row=HEADER_ROW, column=col).value for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)]
for col_idx, value in enumerate(header_values, start=1):
    new_ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=value)

# 篩選並寫入資料
output_row = 2
for row in range(DATA_START_ROW, ws.max_row + 1):
    result = ws.cell(row=row, column=target_col).value
    if result != "無異常":
        for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
            new_ws.cell(row=output_row, column=col, value=ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value)
        output_row += 1

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl
```

```python
# 合併函式：依欄名對應寫入資料
def append_sheet_data(ws_source, source_name):
    # 讀取來源表頭
    headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_source[1]]
    # 建立欄名 -> 欄位索引（0-based）對照

                new_row.append(row[idx])
            else:
                new_row.append(None)
        ws_new.append(new_row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["用料明細"]

# 建立有效欄名對照：第 1 列優先，若為 None（合併群組）則取第 2 列
header_map = {}
for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
    main = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    sub = ws.cell(row=2, column=col).value
    name = main if main is not None else sub
    if name is not None:
        header_map[name] = col

# 目標欄位
target_cols = ["項次", "料號", "品名", "耐候"]
col_idx = {name: header_map[name] for name in target_cols}

# 建立新工作表
new_sheet_name = "耐候異常"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[new_sheet_name]
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_sheet_name)

# 寫入標題
for c, name in enumerate(target_cols, 1):
    new_ws.cell(row=1, column=c, value=name)

# 從第 3 列開始篩選「耐候」不等於「無異常」的資料
out_row = 2
for row in range(3, ws.max_row + 1):
    weather = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx["耐候"]).value
    if weather is None:
        continue
    if str(weather).strip() != "無異常":
        new_ws.cell(row=out_row, column=1, value=ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx["項次"]).value)
        new_ws.cell(row=out_row, column=2, value=ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx["料號"]).value)
        new_ws.cell(row=out_row, column=3, value=ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx["品名"]).value)
        new_ws.cell(row=out_row, column=4, value=weather)
        out_row += 1

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=料表（表頭第1列A-D、第2列E-G）｜欄位=項次、料號、品名、功能｜主檔=料表｜鍵=功能｜篩選=功能≠良品｜輸出=新工作表
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["料表"]

target_fields = ["項次", "料號", "品名", "功能"]
header_locs = {}  # field -> (row, col)

# 在前 3 列內尋找目標欄位（可應對群組標題/子欄位版型）
for r in range(1, 4):
    for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        val = ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value
        if val in target_fields and val not in header_locs:
            header_locs[val] = (r, c)

# 確保四個欄位都找到
missing = [f for f in target_fields if f not in header_locs]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"找不到欄位：{missing}")

# 資料起列 = 標頭列最大者 + 1
data_start_row = max(loc[0] for loc in header_locs.values()) + 1

# 建立新工作表
new_title = "功能非良品"
if new_title in wb.sheetnames:
    new_title = "功能非良品_1"
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_title)
new_ws.append(target_fields)

# 篩選「功能」非「良品」的資料列
func_col = header_locs["功能"][1]
for r in range(data_start_row, ws.max_row + 1):
    func_val = ws.cell(row=r, column=func_col).value
    if func_val is None:
        continue
    if str(func_val).strip() != "良品":
        row_data = [ws.cell(row=r, column=header_locs[f][1]).value for f in target_fields]
        new_ws.append(row_data)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 目標欄位

col_map = {}
max_header_row = 0

for row_idx in range(1, 6):
    for col_idx in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        cell_value = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx).value
        if cell_value in target_headers:
            col_map[cell_value] = col_idx
            if row_idx > max_header_row:
                max_header_row = row_idx

# 資料從表頭的下一列開始
data_start_row = max_header_row + 1

# 建立新工作表
new_sheet_name = "包裝不合格"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[new_sheet_name]
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_sheet_name)

# 寫入新表表頭
for c, header in enumerate(target_headers, start=1):
    new_ws.cell(row=1, column=c, value=header)

# 逐列篩選：包裝不是 "PASS" 的資料列
output_row = 2
for row_idx in range(data_start_row, ws.max_row + 1):

    if str(pkg_value).strip() != "PASS":

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=零件清單（兩層表頭）｜目標欄位=項次、料號、品名、功能｜篩選=功能儲存格值 != "OK"｜輸出=新工作表
import openpyxl

ws = wb["零件清單"]

required = ["項次", "料號", "品名", "功能"]
header_map = {}
header_rows = set()

# 在前 5 列內搜尋所需欄位名稱，建立欄名→欄索引對照
max_scan_row = min(ws.max_row, 5)
for name in required:
    found = False
    for r in range(1, max_scan_row + 1):
        for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
            val = ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value
            if isinstance(val, str) and val.strip() == name:
                header_map[name] = c
                header_rows.add(r)
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    if not found:
        raise ValueError(f"找不到欄位：{name}")

# 資料起於最底層標頭列的下一列
data_start_row = max(header_rows) + 1

# 建立新工作表
new_sheet_name = "功能非OK"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[new_sheet_name]

ws_new.append(required)

# 篩選「功能」不是 "OK" 的列並寫入新工作表
for r in range(data_start_row, ws.max_row + 1):

    if func_val is None:
        continue
    if str(func_val).strip() == "OK":
        continue
    row_data = [ws.cell(row=r, column=header_map[col]).value for col in required]
    ws_new.append(row_data)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```
